icon.description:
Throw a bouncy ball that lasts <hl>40s</hl>.
On enemy hit deal <dmg>$hit_dmg$ $$ddmg$</dmg> and
<kb>launch</kb> <kkb>$kb$1$$kbx$ $kb$2$$kby$</kkb> enemies.

While deployed, you can <h>catch
the ball</h> to retrieve early.
<hl>+{{$charge_per_tick$*20}/$min_charge$} charge</hl> per second
